title: Acme Semiconductor Ltd — supplier profile
body: Sole source for the ASC-4400 and ASC-4410 controllers. Second-sourcing has been open for three quarters; the alternate part qualification is roughly two quarters out as of W28. Buffer stock policy is six weeks of build; actual buffer was five weeks at W29. This is our largest single-supplier exposure and has been flagged as such in successive weekly reports.

title: Northwind Optics GmbH — supplier profile
body: Supplies the NW-LENS-12 assembly. Passed the annual audit in June 2026 with no major findings and no open corrective actions. Lens assembly yields stable. Dual-sourced with a qualified alternate already in production.

title: Kestrel Logistics — EU inbound lane
body: Primary inbound freight lane for European component shipments. Running two to three days behind baseline as of W29, before the port action began. No alternate carrier qualified on this lane.

title: Copilot — architecture overview
body: Copilot fronts every dashboard feature and routes user questions to feature agents. Query latency p95 is 1.4s after the W29 retrieval cache change. The wiki ingestion pipeline writes into per-division namespaces.

title: Incident severity — shared definitions
body: Shared severity vocabulary used across divisions: critical, high, medium, low, none. Severity is assessed against supply impact, not against news prominence.
